source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    pairs = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                    pairs.append((r, c, dr, dc, color))
    for r, c, dr, dc, color in pairs:
        for sr, sc in ((-dr, -dc), (dr, dc)):
            rr, cc = (r, c) if (sr, sc) == (-dr, -dc) else (r + dr, c + dc)
            while 0 <= rr + sr < h and 0 <= cc + sc < w and out[rr + sr][cc + sc] == bg:
                rr += sr
                cc += sc
                out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''

source2='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    values = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg = max(set(values), key=values.count)
    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color == bg:
                    continue
                pr, pc = r - dr, c - dc
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue
                if not (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == color):
                    continue
                run = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    run.append((rr, cc))
                    rr += dr
                    cc += dc
                run_set = set(run)
                for er, ec, sr, sc in ((run[0][0], run[0][1], -dr, -dc), (run[-1][0], run[-1][1], dr, dc)):
                    clear = True
                    for ar in range(max(0, er - 1), min(h, er + 2)):
                        for ac in range(max(0, ec - 1), min(w, ec + 2)):
                            if grid[ar][ac] != bg and (ar, ac) not in run_set:
                                clear = False
                    if not clear:
                        continue
                    rr, cc = er + sr, ec + sc
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == bg:
                        out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr += sr
                        cc += sc
    return out
'''
